s.43B: statutory dues (PF/ESI employer share, bonus, leave encashment, GST, interest to banks) unpaid at year end and not paid by the ITR due date must be added back

s.43B(h): a purchase or expense owed to a micro or small enterprise (manufacturer or service provider, not a trader) is deductible this year only if paid within the MSMED Act s.15 period - 15 days, or the agreed credit term up to 45 days - even when that date falls after 31 March; otherwise it is allowed in the year of payment. msme_dues_at_year_end lists the open bills with their age and pay-by dates: get the payment dates and credit terms, confirm each supplier's Udyam category, and add back the bills not paid in time
s.40(a)(ia): 30% of expenses on which TDS was not deducted/deposited by the ITR due date
s.36(1)(va): employees' PF/ESI contribution deposited after the statutory due date is disallowed in full
s.40A(2)(b): excess payments to related parties; s.37: personal or capital expenditure
Income-tax/deferred tax are below PBT - do not add back again
Turnover of FY-2 decides 25% vs 30% under the normal regime
tax_audit is false: no Form 3CA-3CD; if turnover or receipts cross the s.44AB limits, set tax_audit to true and get the tax audit report before filing
